description.value:
You have mastered chakra circulation at the deepest level. Your proficiency rank for spell DCs and spell attack rolls with the chakra tradition becomes master (proficiency 3).

You learn @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.spells.Item.SpllChrgChak3rd0]{Charge Chakra (Master)}, the rank-3 variant of Charge Chakra: 1 Focus Point and 1-3 actions restore 3, 6, or 9 expended slots (instead of 1, 2, or 3). The full 9-slot output represents a peak chakra exchange — the kind seen in the legendary battles of Sage-level shinobi.
